definitionZh: 确认对话框是用于确认用户操作的专用对话框，用于请求用户确认或取消可能具有破坏性或重要的操作。
sourceDefinition: ConfirmationDialog is a specialized dialog component used to confirm user actions. It provides a simple way to ask users to confirm or cancel potentially destructive or important actions.
